showfilesize.config.title: File Info
showfilesize.command.diagnose: File Info: Diagnose Badge (single-click the file in Explorer first, then run this)
showfilesize.view.name: File Sizes
showfilesize.badge.enabled.description: Show a compact size badge (max 2 chars, e.g. "3K", "45") next to files in the Explorer. Full sizes are always visible in the File Sizes view.
showfilesize.badge.color.description: Color of the size badge. Note: VSCode applies a decoration's color to the file name as well; pick "default" to keep the theme's own color.
showfilesize.badge.format.description: Badge encoding: "full" (default) shows the complete size text as the label (e.g. "1.2 KB", via a CSS variable technique) with a compact fallback badge; "emojiCircle" renders large emoji circled digits with the unit visible (⑫️K = 12K, 1–20 per unit, then emoji keycap pairs); "keycap" uses emoji keycap digits; "wide" fullwidth digits (６K); "circled"/"standard" are the compact ASCII-adjacent forms.
showfilesize.badge.format.full: Full — the complete size text as the label, e.g. 1.2 KB (via a CSS variable technique)
showfilesize.badge.format.circled: Circled — ③K…㊿K, unit always visible (1–50 per unit)
showfilesize.badge.format.wide: Wide — fullwidth digits ６K, ４２ (wider glyphs, same size font)
showfilesize.badge.format.emojiCircle: Emoji circled — large blue-circle emoji digits ⑫️K, unit always visible (1–20 per unit, then keycap pairs)
showfilesize.badge.colorBySize.descripti: Color by size bucket instead of a fixed color: green = under 1 MB, yellow = MBs, red = GB and above. Overrides "badge.color" when enabled.
showfilesize.badge.gitStatus.description: Git status prefix in front of the size text: change letters ("M  1.2 KB") and, for unchanged files inside a git repository, a check mark ("✓  1.2 KB").
showfilesize.badge.gitStatus.all: All — change letters plus ✓ for unchanged files
showfilesize.badge.gitStatus.changed: Changed — change letters only, no ✓ for unchanged files
showfilesize.badge.gitStatus.off: Off — no git prefix at all (badge shows only the size)
showfilesize.folderSize.enabled.descript: Compute and show the total size of folders (recursively) in Explorer decorations. The File Sizes view always computes them for visible rows.
showfilesize.folderSize.ignore.descripti: Directory names to skip when computing folder sizes.
showfilesize.statusbar.enabled.descripti: Show the exact size and modified time of the active file in the status bar.
showfilesize.view.enabled.description: Show the optional File Sizes panel at the bottom of the Explorer sidebar (full sizes per row, e.g. "1.2 KB" — the built-in tree itself is capped to 2-char badges by VSCode).
